entries.title: Approved changes no longer wait on a team's queue the project removed
entries.body: When a project on batched pull requests stops using a team's queue, Infinitary now notices at your next merge and puts your approved changes in a batch of your own. A change you approved while the queue was still there joins your next batch instead of waiting for the queue's check forever.
entries.noPicture: This changes whether an approved change waits or merges; no view is drawn differently.
